description: Boundary and logical-path coverage for extracting a platform UUID from a property-list document: the target key appearing alongside unrelated keys, as the sole key in its entry, and UUID values using different letter cases.

input.plist:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
        <key>IORegistryEntryChildren</key>
        <array>
                <dict>
                        <key>alpha</key>
                        <string>a</string>
                        <key>IOPlatformUUID</key>
                        <string>FFFFFFFF-0000-1111-2222-333344445555</string>
                </dict>
        </array>
</dict>
</plist>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
        <key>IORegistryEntryChildren</key>
        <array>
                <dict>
                        <key>IOPlatformUUID</key>
                        <string>abcdef00-1111-2222-3333-444455556666</string>
                        <key>omega</key>
                        <string>z</string>
                </dict>
        </array>
</dict>
</plist>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
        <key>IORegistryEntryChildren</key>
        <array>
                <dict>
                        <key>IOPlatformUUID</key>
                        <string>00112233-4455-6677-8899-AABBCCDDEEFF</string>
                </dict>
        </array>
</dict>
</plist>
